questions.q: Which data type stores only true or false?
questions.qAf: Watter datatipe stoor net true of false?
questions.explain: boolean loggedIn = true;
questions.explainAf: boolean loggedIn = true;

questions.q: Which of these starts with a capital letter because it is an object type?
questions.qAf: Watter een van hierdie begin met 'n hoofletter omdat dit 'n objektipe is?
questions.explain: Object types (String, Gogga) start with a capital; primitive types start with a small letter.
questions.explainAf: Objektipes (String, Gogga) begin met 'n hoofletter; primitiewe tipes met 'n kleinletter.

questions.q: Which code makes a link that opens in a new tab?
questions.qAf: Watter kode maak 'n skakel wat in 'n nuwe oortjie oopmaak?
questions.explain: href is the address and target="_blank" opens a new tab.
questions.explainAf: href is die adres en target="_blank" maak 'n nuwe oortjie oop.

questions.q: In CSS, which selector styles one unique element?
questions.qAf: Watter CSS-selektor stileer een unieke element?
questions.explain: An ID starts with # and is used once per page; a class is reusable.
questions.explainAf: 'n ID begin met # en word een keer per bladsy gebruik; 'n klas is herbruikbaar.

questions.q: Which colour is rgb(255, 0, 0)?
questions.qAf: Watter kleur is rgb(255, 0, 0)?
questions.explain: Full red, no green, no blue.
questions.explainAf: Volle rooi, geen groen, geen blou.

questions.q: Netflix suggests shows like the ones you watched. Which pillar is this?
questions.qAf: Netflix stel programme voor soos dié waarna jy gekyk het. Watter pilaar is dit?
questions.explain: It finds patterns in what you watched to predict.
questions.explainAf: Dit vind patrone in wat jy gekyk het om te voorspel.

questions.q: A map shows only roads and landmarks. Which pillar is this?
questions.qAf: 'n Kaart wys net paaie en landmerke. Watter pilaar is dit?
questions.explain: Abstraction leaves out unnecessary detail.
questions.explainAf: Abstraksie laat onnodige besonderhede uit.

questions.q: What is the next number in the pattern 4, 6, 10, 16, 24, …?
questions.qAf: Wat is die volgende getal in die patroon 4, 6, 10, 16, 24, …?
questions.explainAf: Verskille +2, +4, +6, +8; volgende +10: 24 + 10 = 34.

questions.q: What removes a degree of freedom in a sketch?
questions.qAf: Wat verwyder 'n vryheidsgraad in 'n skets?
questions.explain: A constraint fixes a size, position or angle, removing a DOF.
questions.explainAf: 'n Beperking maak 'n grootte, posisie of hoek vas en verwyder 'n DOF.

questions.q: The status bar says the sketch still has 2 DOF. What is it?
questions.qAf: Die statusbalk sê die skets het nog 2 DOF. Wat is dit?
questions.explain: Any DOF left means under-constrained.
questions.explainAf: Enige DOF wat oorbly, beteken onderbeperk.

questions.q: A sketch turns orange after a constraint is added. What does this mean?
questions.qAf: 'n Skets word oranje nadat 'n beperking bygevoeg is. Wat beteken dit?
questions.explain: Too many constraints conflict, which causes errors.
questions.explainAf: Te veel beperkings bots, wat foute veroorsaak.

questions.q: What does PWM do?
questions.qAf: Wat doen PWM?
options: Copies different power levels by switching on and off very quickly
optionsAf: Boots kragvlakke na deur baie vinnig aan en af te skakel
questions.explain: PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) controls speed by switching quickly.
questions.explainAf: PWM (pulswydtemodulasie) beheer spoed deur vinnig te skakel.

questions.q: Which pins can produce a PWM signal?
questions.qAf: Watter penne kan 'n PWM-sein lewer?

questions.q: Which of these is an analog input?
questions.qAf: Watter een is 'n analoë inset?
questions.explain: Sensors with a range of values are analog inputs; a pushbutton is digital.
questions.explainAf: Sensors met 'n reeks waardes is analoë insette; 'n drukknoppie is digitaal.

questions.q: A continuous-rotation servo is given the value 90. What does it do?
questions.qAf: 'n Servo met aaneenlopende rotasie kry die waarde 90. Wat doen dit?
questions.explain: 90 = stop, 0 = full reverse, 180 = full forward.
questions.explainAf: 90 = stop, 0 = vol agteruit, 180 = vol vorentoe.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: Java statements end with a full stop.
questions.qAf: Java-stellings eindig met 'n punt.
questions.explain: They end with a semicolon (;).
questions.explainAf: Hulle eindig met 'n kommapunt (;).

questions.q: is a self-closing tag.
questions.qAf: is 'n selfsluitende etiket.
questions.explain:
,
and do not wrap content.
questions.explainAf:
,
en omsluit nie inhoud nie.

questions.q: An algorithm may have vague steps, because a robot will work out what you mean.
questions.qAf: 'n Algoritme mag vae stappe hê, want 'n robot sal uitwerk wat jy bedoel.
questions.explain: Robots have no intuition, so the steps must be precise.
questions.explainAf: Robotte het geen intuïsie nie, dus moet die stappe presies wees.

questions.q: Decomposition means breaking a complex problem into smaller, manageable parts.
questions.qAf: Ontbinding beteken om 'n komplekse probleem in kleiner, hanteerbare dele op te breek.
questions.explain: That is decomposition.
questions.explainAf: Dit is ontbinding.

questions.q: A fully constrained sketch can shift by accident.
questions.qAf: 'n Volledig beperkte skets kan per ongeluk skuif.
questions.explain: Fully constrained means zero DOF, so it cannot shift, and the model is the same every time it is opened.
questions.explainAf: Volledig beperk beteken nul DOF, dus kan dit nie skuif nie, en die model is elke keer dieselfde.

questions.q: Analog output accepts values from 0 to 1023.
questions.qAf: Analoë uitset aanvaar waardes van 0 tot 1023.
questions.explain: Analog output accepts 0 to 255; analog input gives 0 to 1023.
questions.explainAf: Analoë uitset aanvaar 0 tot 255; analoë inset gee 0 tot 1023.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each language in column A with the way a comment is written in it in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke taal in kolom A by die manier waarop 'n kommentaar daarin geskryf word in kolom B.
questions.explain: Java: //, HTML: <!-- -->, CSS: /* */. The extra one (#) was not one of the three we used.
questions.explainAf: Java: //, HTML: <!-- -->, CSS: /* */. Die ekstra een (#) was nie een van die drie wat ons gebruik het nie.

questions.q: Match each chart in column A with what it shows in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke grafiek in kolom A by wat dit wys in kolom B.
pairs: A filled-in line chart showing the volume of change
pairsAf: 'n Ingekleurde lyngrafiek wat die omvang van verandering wys
questions.explain: The extra description belongs to a bar or column chart.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing behoort aan 'n staaf- of kolomgrafiek.

questions.q: A robot factory: match each part in column A with its place in the IPO model in column B.
questions.qAf: 'n Robotfabriek: pas elke deel in kolom A by sy plek in die IPO-model in kolom B.
pairs: Calculating how many bolts are needed
questions.explain: Input is what is needed, Process is the calculation or work, and Output is the result.
questions.explainAf: Inset is wat nodig is, Verwerking is die berekening of werk, en Uitset is die resultaat.

sections.title: Missing syntax
sections.intro: Type the missing symbol or word in each box.
sections.introAf: Tik die simbool of woord wat ontbreek in elke blokkie.

questions.q: Type the symbol that must end this Java statement.
questions.qAf: Tik die simbool wat hierdie Java-stelling moet afsluit.
questions.explain: Every Java statement ends with a semicolon.
questions.explainAf: Elke Java-stelling eindig met 'n kommapunt.

questions.q: Type the symbol missing from this closing tag.
questions.qAf: Tik die simbool wat in hierdie sluitetiket ontbreek.
questions.explain: A closing tag has a forward slash: .
questions.explainAf: 'n Sluitetiket het 'n skuinsstreep: .

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put the steps for a plate with a row of holes in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe vir 'n plaat met 'n ry gate in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: Sketch and Pad a fully constrained rectangle
Sketch one circle on the top face
Pocket the circle Through All (the seed)
Select the Pocket and apply a Linear Pattern
stepsAf: Skets en Pad 'n volledig beperkte reghoek
Skets een sirkel op die boonste vlak
Pocket die sirkel Through All (die saadkenmerk)
Kies die Pocket en pas 'n Linear Pattern toe
questions.explain: The seed Pocket is made first, then copied by the pattern.
questions.explainAf: Die saad-Pocket word eerste gemaak en dan deur die patroon gekopieer.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Sipho writes this program for his Gogga, ant.
questions.scenarioAf: Sipho skryf hierdie program vir sy Gogga, ant.

questions.q: How many times does ant.move() run altogether?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer word ant.move() altesaam uitgevoer?
questions.explain: Inner loop 4 moves × outer loop 3 times = 12.
questions.explainAf: Binneste lus 4 bewegings × buitenste lus 3 keer = 12.

questions.q: How many times does ant turn right?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer draai ant regs?
questions.explain: turnRight() runs once each time the outer loop runs: 3 times.
questions.explainAf: turnRight() word een keer uitgevoer elke keer as die buitenste lus loop: 3 keer.

questions.q: Which loop moves the Gogga along one side?
questions.qAf: Watter lus beweeg die Gogga langs een sy?
questions.explain: The inner loop draws one side; the outer loop repeats sides and turns.
questions.explainAf: Die binneste lus teken een sy; die buitenste lus herhaal die sye en draai.

questions.q: What is sides++ short for?
questions.qAf: Waarvoor is sides++ kort?
questions.explain: ++ adds 1: it is the increment.
questions.explainAf: ++ tel 1 by: dit is die inkrement.

questions.q: The loop that uses sides is the inner loop.
questions.qAf: Die lus wat sides gebruik, is die binneste lus.
questions.explain: sides is the outer loop; counter is the inner loop.
questions.explainAf: sides is die buitenste lus; counter is die binneste lus.

questions.q: Sipho wants each side to be 6 moves long. Type the number that goes in the inner loop's condition.
questions.qAf: Sipho wil hê elke sy moet 6 bewegings lank wees. Tik die getal wat in die binneste lus se voorwaarde kom.
questions.explain: Starting at 0, counter < 6 runs 6 times.
questions.explainAf: Met 0 as begin loop counter < 6 ses keer.

questions.scenario: Mr Dlamini types the marks of his 30 learners in B2:B31. Two learners were absent, so their cells are empty.
questions.scenarioAf: Mnr. Dlamini tik die punte van sy 30 leerders in B2:B31. Twee leerders was afwesig, dus is hulle selle leeg.

questions.q: What does =COUNT(B2:B31) give?
questions.qAf: Wat gee =COUNT(B2:B31)?
questions.explain: COUNT counts numbers only and ignores empty cells.
questions.explainAf: COUNT tel net getalle en ignoreer leë selle.

questions.q: What does =COUNTBLANK(B2:B31) give?
questions.qAf: Wat gee =COUNTBLANK(B2:B31)?
questions.explain: Only the empty cells are counted.
questions.explainAf: Net die leë selle word getel.

questions.q: Which formula gives the class average?
questions.qAf: Watter formule gee die klasgemiddelde?
questions.explain: AVERAGE of the whole range; =AVERAGE(B2,B31) uses only two cells.
questions.explainAf: AVERAGE van die hele reeks; =AVERAGE(B2,B31) gebruik net twee selle.

questions.q: Type the symbol missing from this formula for the top mark.
questions.qAf: Tik die simbool wat in hierdie formule vir die hoogste punt ontbreek.
questions.explain: The colon means “through to”: B2 through to B31.
questions.explainAf: Die dubbelpunt beteken “tot en met”: B2 tot en met B31.

questions.q: Which chart best compares the marks of the different learners?
questions.qAf: Watter grafiek vergelyk die punte van die verskillende leerders die beste?
questions.explain: Bar or column charts compare categories.
questions.explainAf: Staaf- of kolomgrafieke vergelyk kategorieë.

questions.scenario: Kabelo powers an LED from a 9 V battery. The LED drops 2 V, and he wants a current of 14 mA (0.014 A).
questions.scenarioAf: Kabelo dryf 'n LED met 'n 9 V-battery aan. Die LED se spanningsval is 2 V, en hy wil 'n stroom van 14 mA (0,014 A) hê.

questions.q: What voltage must the resistor take?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel spanning moet oor die resistor val?

questions.q: Which resistor does he need?
questions.qAf: Watter resistor het hy nodig?

questions.q: Why does the LED need this resistor?
questions.qAf: Hoekom het die LED hierdie resistor nodig?
options: Its low internal resistance would draw too much current and burn it out
optionsAf: Sy lae interne weerstand sou te veel stroom trek en dit laat uitbrand
questions.explain: A current-limiting resistor in series protects the LED.
questions.explainAf: 'n Stroombeperkende resistor in serie beskerm die LED.
